decision: This upstream patch reverts the direct MDC switch handle-path experiment to descendant selectors. The owned Material-16 slide-toggle CSS uses historical `.mat-slide-toggle-*` roles. The package exports a historical M2 `slide-toggle-theme`, but slide-toggle is outside the thirteen-family current-companion roster and the module has no `mat.slide-toggle-overrides` call; `legacy-slide-toggle-theme` is the owned legacy theme. Do not port the peer selector revert into legacy CSS; no current-peer M2 slide-toggle bridge qualification is claimed.
peer_coexistence_unresolved: No thirteen-family current-peer slide-toggle bridge is declared; the exported slide-toggle-theme is historical M2 and has no mat.slide-toggle-overrides call. Do not turn unsupported use on current peer into a new package-level peer-state obligation.
